To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
human semaphorines A(V) and semaphorin 4 (IV) are located in chromosome region 21.3, which is frequently deleted in small cell lung cancer.
two new members of the human Semaphorin (Sema) family were identified and characterized in chromosome region 1p21.3.

we have identified two additional genes of the semaphorin/collapsin family, which are located on chromosome region 3 p21.3, a region where several small cell carcinoma of the lung (SCLC)-derived cell lines exhibit homo-zygous deletional mutations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular characterization and expression of semaphorin-related genes in human tissues, with an emphasis on their potential role as tumor suppressor genes.
the characterization of the human sema genes, their products and expression in normal tissues and tumors.
the identification of novel tumor suppressor genes on chromosome 3p21, which may play a role in the development of lung cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the human semaphorrins A(V) (and IV) are located in the small cell lung cancer region of chromosome 3 and are differentially expressed in lung cancer.
the semaphorins are a large family of genes with diverse functions and are involved in many biological processes.
the expression of semaphorin is not a tumor marker for SCLC, and that the expression pattern of semaphorins is different in SCLC and non-SCLC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the human semaphorrins A(V)and IV reside in the small cell lung cancer 3p21 deletion region and demonstrate differential expression patterns.
we identified 3 genes (GNAI-2, GNAT-1, and semaphorin) that reside in the 2.5-Mb 3p21 region of small cell lung cancer.
we have identified two new semaphorin-like genes, human semaphorine A(V) and semaphorin (IV).
The main takeaway from our work is that
we identified a novel gene family, semaphorins, that are expressed in the lung.

we have identified two new semaphorin-like genes, human semaphorina A(V) and semaphorin I, that map in the small cell lung cancer homozygous deletion region of 3p21 and that have distinct tissue expression patterns and may be involved in tumor suppression.
semaphorin expression in the lung is not restricted to the nervous system and may play a role in the pathophysiology of lung cancer.
